say:1:1530702001:1.text: The kind that stops bleeding. Some of the hunters are injured.
say:1:1530702001:1.source_cn: 止血的药草，给打猎受了伤的战士们用。
say:1:1530702001:1.male: The kind that stops bleeding. Some of the hunters are injured.
say:1:1530702001:1.female: The kind that stops bleeding. Some of the hunters are injured.

say:2:1530702002:1.text: With so many warriors in Wrathwood Grove, we're always running out of herbs. Why hasn't anyone started growing them?
say:2:1530702002:1.source_cn: 树怒山谷的战士太多，需要的药草也多。唉，为什么没人想着...
say:2:1530702002:1.male: With so many warriors in Wrathwood Grove, we're always running out of herbs. Why hasn't anyone started growing them?
say:2:1530702002:1.female: With so many warriors in Wrathwood Grove, we're always running out of herbs. Why hasn't anyone started growing them?
